title: How to Endure to the End

sections.label: MAIN TEXT
sections.title: How to Endure to the End
sections.point: He that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

sections.label: INTRODUCTION
sections.title: You Can Make It
sections.point: Many will fall away, but many will also endure. God desires that we finish the race.

verses.text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

sections.group: I. Three Battles We Must Fight
sections.label: BATTLE 01 / 03
sections.title: The Battle of the Mind
sections.point: Guard your thoughts. Do not allow discouragement, negativity, or the past to pull you away from God.

verses.text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

sections.group: I. Three Battles We Must Fight
sections.label: BATTLE 02 / 03
sections.title: The Battle of Daily Consecration
sections.point: Consecration is a daily surrender, not simply church attendance.

verses.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

sections.group: I. Three Battles We Must Fight
sections.label: BATTLE 03 / 03
sections.title: The Battle of Our Relationships
sections.point: Pursue peace, release bitterness, and refuse to let offenses cause your love to grow cold.

verses.text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

sections.group: II. Three Ways to Keep Enduring
sections.label: PRACTICE 01 / 03
sections.title: Develop a Life of Thanksgiving
sections.point: Gratitude keeps our hearts focused on God's faithfulness, even in difficult circumstances.

verses.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

sections.group: II. Three Ways to Keep Enduring
sections.label: PRACTICE 02 / 03
sections.title: Develop a Life of Prayer
sections.point: Constant communion with Jesus gives us strength to resist temptation and remain faithful.

verses.text: Pray without ceasing.
And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

sections.group: II. Three Ways to Keep Enduring
sections.label: PRACTICE 03 / 03
sections.title: Take Heed Lest You Fall
sections.point: Remain spiritually watchful, humble, and dependent upon God.

verses.text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

sections.group: III. The Mindset of Those Who Endure
sections.label: MINDSET 01 / 03
sections.title: Live Awake: Understand the Time
sections.point: Recognize the urgency of the hour and refuse spiritual complacency.

verses.text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

sections.group: III. The Mindset of Those Who Endure
sections.label: MINDSET 02 / 03
sections.title: Live Ready: Keep Oil in Your Lamp
sections.point: Develop a personal walk with God and remain prepared for Christ's return.

verses.text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

sections.group: III. The Mindset of Those Who Endure
sections.label: MINDSET 03 / 03
sections.title: Live Faithfully: Endure as a Good Soldier
sections.point: Remain committed to Christ through hardship, determined to finish the race.

verses.text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

sections.label: CONCLUSION
sections.title: I Want to Finish
sections.point: Endurance comes from keeping our eyes on Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith.
sections.declaration: I don't just want to start with Jesus. I want to finish with Jesus.

verses.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
